list: All 55 official trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden on PlayStation until earned. Names, descriptions and grades are as PlayStation publishes them, taken from the official list via Exophase and PSNProfiles and cross-checked 18 Nov 2026. Every trophy is offline single-player — the game has no online trophies.
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles — planetgta6.com/en/gta-6-trophies/
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap — pushsquare.com/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-and-roadmap
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap — keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/
gamemapa.com — All 55 GTA 6 Trophies — gamemapa.com/en/gta-6/guides/gta-6-trophy-achievement-list/
Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List — insider-gaming.com/complete-gta-6-trophy-list-how-to-get-all-trophies-achievements/
status_note: The game released in November 2026 and the community has not verified a missable list yet. Five hidden trophies are fully unsolved (Challenging Tank, In The Beginning…, Capital Offense, Personal Best, The Truth Is Out There) and two more have only an unverified likely reading (Bad Luck, I Guess; Ten Pin) — their guides say so instead of inventing a method. Counts (250 stunts of 397, 42 shooting-range challenges at 12 ranges, 14 drone-race locations, 18 meditation spots, 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK scans, 50 of 80 challenges, 52 areas, 9 gangs, 8 garages, 500 profile actions) are cross-checked community figures from gamemapa.com and KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum arrives on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are earned — there is no separate task for it. Work the roadmap in order: story, stranger strands, activities, collectibles, open-world lists, then the 100% clean-up. Push Square estimates the full hunt at up to 300 hours, the story alone around 60, so treat it as a season-long project, not a weekend.
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, through to its completion screen. It is the first mission of the story, so every player earns it by simply following the objectives. Keep a manual save before major missions as a habit — no verified missable list exists yet, though nothing in the official description suggests this one can be missed.
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. Chapter trophies come from story progress alone, so work the main missions in order and this pops when the chapter closes. Side activities between missions do not count toward it — only the story missions do.
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete all of Chapter 2's missions. The asterisks are part of the official name exactly as PlayStation publishes it — not a censor added by this guide. Like the other chapter trophies it unlocks at the chapter's close from story progress alone.
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete every mission in Chapter 3. By this point stranger strands start opening — Andy, Kenton and the rest — but the chapter trophy only needs the main missions. Leave the stranger missions for the post-story clean-up.
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4, the last full chapter before the finale. Save manually as the chapter nears its end — a save costs nothing and no missable list is verified yet. After this chapter closes, only the final mission stands between you and the story's gold trophy.
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.time: Story, ~60 hours to reach it (reviews via VGC / Push Square)
trophies.guide: Complete the final story mission. Reviews put the story at roughly 60 hours; finishing it does not end your save — you keep free-roaming Leonida, and Push Square notes a 100% completion checklist unlocks after the story. Do the story first, then mop up everything else in free roam.
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
planetgta6.com — story length ~60 hours per reviews

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Play the story mission Breakfast Run to its completion screen. Named-mission trophies ask only that you finish the mission — failing and retrying from a checkpoint does not lock you out.
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist, one of the game's big set-piece heists. Heists run longer and harder than regular missions, so stock up on ammunition and armour first and lean on the checkpoints. The trophy is for finishing, not for any particular approach.
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Like every named-mission trophy, the official description asks only that you finish that mission — follow its objectives to the end and it pops on completion.
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. DWNFALL is a stylised spelling from the official list, not a typo in this guide. Finish the mission and the trophy unlocks.
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, set around Vice City International Airport. Expect heavy combat — bring a solid rifle, move between cover, and let the checkpoints carry you through the harder stretches. Finishing is all the trophy asks.
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory, one of the later named missions — it comes after plenty of practice with combat and driving. Play it through to the end; the trophy is tied to completion, not to a score or a tactic.
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist, which Push Square says unlocks after you finish the story (under Progress / Stats). Rockstar has not published exactly what the checklist covers, but the visible trophies map most of it: story, stranger strands, collectibles, activities and the open-world lists. Work this guide's roadmap stage by stage and check the in-game list after each stage — it is the only authoritative record of what is left.
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 stunts across Leonida. The cross-checked community total is 397 stunts — jumps, under-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps — so you need roughly two-thirds of them. Many happen naturally while driving and flying; for the rest, work stunt jumps one area at a time. A stunt counts once completed, not merely attempted.
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
gamemapa.com — 397 stunts in total
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types at least once: fishing, hunting, golf, the shooting range, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt (gamemapa's cross-checked list). You do not need to be good at any of them — just start and finish one of each. Do it early, while learning the map; it doubles as a tour of what Leonida offers.
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
gamemapa.com — the 9 activity types

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 shooting ranges (gamemapa's cross-checked figures). This is the list's skill test: learn each range's weapon and target pattern, take the first runs slowly to learn the layout, then chase gold. If a challenge keeps beating you, leave it and return after more story practice — no range is missable.
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
gamemapa.com — 42 challenges, 12 ranges
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Drone races are a separate activity from car races — learn the drone's handling first; smooth lines beat jerky corrections, and cutting corners through gates saves more time than raw speed. Win one race per location; the trophy tracks locations, not total wins.
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different events, not the same race 20 times. Mix race types (street, off-road, boat and air where available) and spread them across the map so you also progress on exploring Leonida. A competitive car in the class you race matters more than perfect driving, so spend a little laundered cash on one before grinding these.
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.time: Under 1 hour once fishing is learned
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing is one of the nine activity types, so this also feeds Master of None. Learn the fishing mini-game's rhythm first — steady reeling with the line tension in mind — then take on Cal's challenge. Losing does not lock anything out; you can retry.
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game — finish it, not just start it. Find an arcade machine in Leonida, pick a game, and play it through to its end screen. One of the quickest trophies on the list, and it counts toward trying the activity types for Master of None.
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy's final mission. Andy's strand is one of the stranger mission chains: meet Andy, work through his missions in order, and the trophy pops on the last one. Gamemapa reports Andy's chain as 5 quests, Lucia only, from Chapter 3 — treat that as a community report, not an official fact.
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
gamemapa.com — Andy's chain, community report

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's final mission. Like the other stranger strands, Kenton's missions unlock as you meet him in the open world and play his chain in order — the trophy is for the last mission, so there is no shortcut. Do the stranger strands after the story, when you can roam freely and pick them up one by one.
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's final mission. Billy's strand is another stranger chain: find him in the open world, finish his missions in sequence, and the trophy unlocks on the final one. If a stranger does not appear, advance the story a little — stranger missions often unlock at certain story points.
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. This is the umbrella trophy for the side characters: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret each have a strand, plus other strangers scattered around the state. Finish any 8 full strands — the individual final-mission trophies count toward it. Check your progress in the game's stats and mop up unstarted strands after the story.
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's final mission. Randy's strand is one of the stranger chains counted toward Strangers & Freaks, so finishing it moves two trophies at once. Work through his missions in order in free roam after the story, when every stranger location is open.
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's final mission. Tyrone's chain is another stranger strand: meet him, play his missions in order, and the trophy pops on the last one. Clear all five named stranger strands plus three more and Strangers & Freaks comes with them.
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida (gamemapa's cross-checked count). Meditation spots are a collectible-style checklist: visit each one and meditate there. Warning — gamemapa reports that one meditation spot is missable, so do not leave this for the very end: start visiting spots as you explore, and keep a manual save before story beats that change the world. That missable claim is a community report, not confirmed by Rockstar, and this guide flags it rather than stating it as fact.
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
gamemapa.com — 18 spots, one reported missable

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's strand involves hunting, so bring a scoped rifle and track the animal patiently — unique animals are usually found in one specific area, and the hunt is the point, not a quick kill. This is a hidden trophy, so the official description gives no location; community hunting guides will name the animal and its area once verified, and this guide will not guess at either.
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. There are 18 card sets in total (gamemapa's cross-checked count), so you only need three — pick the sets whose cards cluster in areas you already visit and finish those first. Cards are scattered across Leonida, so collect them as you explore rather than hunting them all in one sweep; a card checklist or map from a community guide helps, but check it against your in-game count.
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
gamemapa.com — 18 card sets

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app to scan 100 locations across Leonida — landmarks, curiosities and sculptures (gamemapa). WAiNK scanning is the game's photo/scan collectible: open the app at a point of interest and scan it. Scan everything you pass while doing other things and the count climbs on its own; for the last few, sweep the map region by region.
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
gamemapa.com — landmarks, curiosities, sculptures

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges (gamemapa's cross-checked count). Challenges are small objectives spread across activities — stunts, races, combat, exploration — so this trophy advances while you chase the others. Check the challenge list in the game regularly and pick off the easy ones you have not done; you need 50 of 80, so the hardest ones can be skipped.
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
gamemapa.com — 50 of 80 challenges

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside you, build up a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. Do it away from tight city streets if you can — open roads and the countryside give room to break line of sight, and a fast car with good handling helps more than a fast car with bad brakes. Your partner must be with you when the wanted level drops, so do not let them get separated during the chase.
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back without losing your wanted level — meaning you must keep the heat on through all three robberies, not escape between them. Plan a route of three close shops, hit them fast, and keep a getaway car parked nearby for the escape afterwards. One of the trickier partner trophies, so expect a few attempts; a failed run costs nothing but time.
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles across Leonida. A WAiNK scan of a vehicle is enough to count it (gamemapa), so scan every new vehicle you see while exploring — parked cars, boats, aircraft and the oddities count too. This climbs naturally alongside You WAiNKer! and The Goodtime State, so do not grind it alone: just scan as you go.
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
gamemapa.com — a WAiNK scan counts

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the game's slow-down aiming mode — trigger it when a group of enemies is bunched up, then work through them quickly while time is slowed. Pick a busy fight with weak enemies rather than a boss encounter, and use a fast-firing weapon so you can drop five before the focus ends.
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport — in plain terms, steal a plane (or otherwise take off) from VCIA without a ticket or a flight plan. Get onto the airfield, grab an aircraft and take off. Expect a wanted level, so be ready to fly away fast once airborne. This is a hidden trophy, so the official description is deliberately vague, but the airport setting makes the intent clear.
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — one of the five hidden trophies the community has not solved yet. The description is a joke about Rhino tanks, and its exact unlock has no verified method. The sensible reading is that it involves the Rhino tank: finding one, driving one, or surviving an encounter with one. Do not chase this blindly; check a verified community guide once one exists, and this guide flags the trophy as unsolved rather than inventing steps for it.
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
gamemapa.com — listed among unsolved hidden trophies

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected — a stealth robbery, not a smash-and-grab. Case the store first, plan your entry, keep quiet, and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, the attempt fails, so restart rather than fighting your way out. Stealth gear and patience matter more than firepower here.
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Bank vault robberies are the big open-world heists: plan the approach, crack the vault, grab the cash and get away clean — escaping is part of the trophy, not optional. Do them one at a time and let the heat die down between attempts; five clean escapes earn the silver.
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks roam Leonida's roads — spot one, stop it, crack it open and take the cash, then lose the wanted level that follows. A good ambush spot is a quiet stretch of road where you can block the truck and work fast. Escaping after the robbery is part of the trophy, so have a getaway car ready.
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore every area of Leonida. The cross-checked community figure is 52 areas to visit (gamemapa's report, via the official description's explore-everywhere wording). Drive, fly and sail through each region — the map fills in as you go, and the trophy pops when the last area registers. Combine this with WAiNK scanning, vehicle discovery and meditation spots so one sweep of the map feeds four trophies at once.
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
gamemapa.com — 52 areas, community report

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs (gamemapa's cross-checked count). Illegal operations are gang-run spots around the map — hit one per gang and the trophy pops. Gangs will not like it, so expect resistance and a wanted level; go in prepared and get out fast. A community map of gang territories helps you find the last one or two.
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
gamemapa.com — 9 gangs

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — one of the five hidden trophies the community has not solved yet. The description names a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, so the shape is a quiet moment at a beachfront bar — but the exact bar and trigger are still unverified, and the description names the beach, not the bar. If it does not pop at the first likely spot, try other beachfront bars. No location is asserted here because none is verified yet.
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
gamemapa.com — listed among unsolved hidden trophies

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — one of the five hidden trophies the community has not solved yet. The description asks you to smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — a nod to the series' famous opening moments — but the exact showroom is still unconfirmed. Try the most prominent vehicle showroom you find; the trophy should pop the moment you break out. Do not buy the car first — the point is the exit, not the purchase.
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
gamemapa.com — listed among unsolved hidden trophies

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — play a game of bowling there. Bowling is one of the pastime activities, so a full game at this specific alley should pop the trophy on completion. The alley's name is in the official description, so this one names its own location; if the trophy does not pop after one game, finish the game properly rather than quitting early.
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — one of the five hidden trophies the community has not solved yet. The description — a partnership with mass appeal — is deliberately vague, and no verified method exists. The likely reading is a moment where you and your partner do something that draws a crowd or goes public, but this guide will not invent steps for it: check a verified community guide once the method is confirmed, and tick it off then.
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
gamemapa.com — listed among unsolved hidden trophies

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make choices that affect your Criminal Profile — gamemapa's cross-checked figure is 500 actions that affect it. This is a cumulative counter, not a single decision: every choice you make in missions and the open world that shifts your profile adds up. Play normally, make decisions rather than avoiding them, and check your profile counter in the game's stats to see how close you are.
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
gamemapa.com — 500 actions, community report

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — the description (second time's the charm) suggests succeeding at something on your second attempt after failing once, but the exact trigger is still unverified. The most sensible reading is to retry something you failed and succeed: a failed mission, race or challenge, completed on the second try. Do not force it; it will likely pop naturally while you play, and this guide flags it as unconfirmed rather than guessing the trigger.
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
gamemapa.com — listed among unsolved hidden trophies

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — one of the five hidden trophies the community has not solved yet. The description points at something strange — an event, easter egg or random encounter — and its method is still unverified. Gamemapa lists it among the five still-unsolved hidden trophies. The honest advice is to explore widely, investigate odd happenings instead of driving past them, and watch for verified community reports once players pin the trigger down. No location or event is asserted here because none is verified.
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
gamemapa.com — one of five unsolved hidden trophies

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — knock someone over with a melee drive-by: a melee attack from a moving vehicle. The precise method is still being confirmed by the community (KeenGamer), but the shape of it is clear: be a passenger or driver, swing a melee weapon at a pedestrian as you pass, and connect. Pick a slow vehicle and a quiet street so you can line the hit up, and expect a few attempts before it lands.
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
KeenGamer — precise method still being confirmed

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.time: Across the game, tied to robberies
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills are dirty money from robberies and heists — clean them through your contacts in batches, and the counter climbs with each laundered dollar. Do your bank vaults, armored trucks and shop robberies first so you have bills to launder, and keep laundering as you go rather than saving it all for the end.
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in Leonida. This is a cumulative spend counter — clothes, food, ammo, vehicle upgrades and property extras all count. It will climb on its own as you gear up for races and robberies; if you are close at the end, spend the remainder on vehicle upgrades, which are useful anyway. Do not waste money early just to rush it — the cash is better spent on the cars and gear the harder trophies need.
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.time: Late game, once cash is flowing
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties (gamemapa's cross-checked count). Garages are bought with clean money, so launder your Marked Bills first and save for them deliberately — they are also useful, since they store the vehicles you discover for Whip It Good. Check the property listings as you explore and buy each garage when you can afford it; the trophy pops on the last purchase.
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
gamemapa.com — 8 garage properties

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app is the in-game way to log vehicles you find — register each new vehicle you discover and the count climbs alongside Whip It Good's 100 discoveries. You only need 10 registered, so this one finishes long before the vehicle hunt does. Keep the app open while exploring so registering becomes a habit.
sources: Official trophy list (PSN) via Exophase & PSNProfiles
